scope: Read-only review of current source; no Docker container or flight scenario started by reviewer

facts.details: ROS package at /opt/px4_ros_ws/src/drone_agricole_px4_bridge; ../../../simulation/tests resolves /opt/simulation/tests; Dockerfile copies TestOffboardSafety.cpp there.
GET health verifies API and DRONE_AGRICOLE_SITL only. It does not verify odometry freshness, PX4 identity, model or image.
Wall time budgets: waiting data12s, arming10s, global100s, landing35s. Supervisor150s then INT/TERM40s/KILL50s grace. Current Linux binaries still require compilation.
offboard_loss_flag only set while failsafe_gap. VehicleStatus AUTO_LAND may be handled before FailsafeFlags; inspect event ordering and independently record flags.
Request stop after armed_and_offboard or mission_stage and before landing. Pre-arm cancel can finalize failure with no confirmed landing; cancel during landing does not replace pending result reason.
Signal group includes ros2 run Python wrapper and C++ node. Verify result finalization and absence of child after cancel rather than relying on HTTP accepted or parent exit.
ready checks receive ages before initial warmup only; mission_stage uses last status and odometry without freshness guard. Landing confirmation requires receive ages <1s.
Raw result parameters omit stage_timeout_s and fixed budgets although API status retains requested stage_timeout_s; preserve exact API request and source hashes in execution evidence.

inspection_commands: docker compose exec -T px4-runner-api bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash; source /opt/px4_ros_ws/install/setup.bash; ros2 pkg prefix drone_agricole_px4_bridge; command -v setsid; command -v kill'
docker compose exec -T px4-state-bridge ros2 topic list -t
docker compose exec -T px4-state-bridge timeout 6 ros2 topic hz /fmu/out/vehicle_odometry
docker compose exec -T px4-state-bridge timeout 6 ros2 topic hz /fmu/out/vehicle_status_v4
docker compose exec -T px4-state-bridge timeout 5 ros2 topic echo /fmu/out/vehicle_land_detected --once
docker compose exec -T px4-state-bridge timeout 5 ros2 topic echo /fmu/out/battery_status_v1 --once

preconditions: Only one isolated SITL model. No devices, privileged or host network. Verify container/image/model preflight and source/binary hashes.
Fresh NED odometry and VehicleStatus, grounded and disarmed initially. Health sitl_locked=true.
Use new result directory per attempt; preserve x500 historical runtime and separate cartographe runtime.
Preserve exact API payload and response; root performs bounded polling and artifact/T0 finalization.
protocol.api_start: POST http://127.0.0.1:8091/api/run/start Content-Type application/json; expect HTTP202
protocol.api_poll: GET http://127.0.0.1:8091/api/run/status every <=1s; operator bound210s; request safe stop upon no progress/limit and inspect PX4 state
square_accept: Five target_reached events: takeoff, leg_north/east/south/west; every error_m below0.35m (existing runner regression criterion only).
reason=square_completed, success=true, offboard_entered=true, armed=true, landing_confirmed=true, state=completed, exit_code=0.
No unexpected failsafe; result JSON readable, binary/source/image/model hashes preserved; T0 independently validated.
failsafe_accept: Same mission; stream_stopped event precedes offboard_loss_action with nav_state18 expected_land=true.
No proprietary NAV_LAND command21 between stream_stopped and observed autonomous AUTO_LAND action.
Measure loss-to-action latency; max6s is runner cutoff, COM_OF_LOSS_T=1.0 is configured trigger.
reason=offboard_loss_land_observed, success=true, landing_confirmed=true, completed exit0; record flag race or mismatch explicitly.
cancel_accept: Start fresh square request; wait armed mission before POST /api/run/stop.
Observe abort_requested reason signal_interrupt, landing transition, command NAV_LAND21, fresh landed+disarmed.
Raw success=false reason=signal_interrupt, landing_confirmed=true; API cancelled with normal node exit1, no child process remains.
No absent/unreadable result, unconfirmed landing, supervisor timeout or crash may count as successful cancellation.
negative_cases: execute:=false with SITL env1: refuse exit2, no command publication.
execute:=true with DRONE_AGRICOLE_SITL missing or0: refuse exit2, no command publication.
API malformed/incomplete parameters or traversal path: HTTP400; unknown field execute is rejected.
Concurrent valid start while child active: HTTP409; do not overwrite current run.
limits: No scenario outcome asserted by this review.
Synthetic cartographe dynamics do not establish prototype physical fidelity.
No calibrated battery telemetry injected into PX4; default SITL battery does not estimate endurance.
